summary: Refreshed after merging main at 53314d2 (#192: test/smoke_container.sh refuses under Git Bash, MSYS2 and Cygwin; it changed the smoke_container.sh line in AGENTS.md and added a changelog section, both kept beside this PR's lines; none of this PR's other paths). The merged tree was checked again; this PR's own content is unchanged. CI and tooling only; router, agent, the decision services and their images are unchanged. New workflow .github/workflows/decision-images.yml builds the decision-embed and decision-jevlike images (the directories besides router/ whose base images Dependabot updates) with the new test/smoke_decision_images.sh, on pull_request when a file that goes into an image changes, weekly and on workflow_dispatch (ADR-0127, proposed). Traced B9: trigger is pull_request (not pull_request_target), so candidate code runs with the read-only GITHUB_TOKEN and without secrets, as in ci.yml's container job; workflow permissions contents: read; checkout pinned to the same commit SHA as ci.yml with persist-credentials: false; the matrix value reaches the script through env (SERVICE) and is quoted, not interpolated into the shell; nothing is pushed or published; the import check runs with --network none. The script refuses an unknown service name and a missing Dockerfile before acting, builds with the build context of the service directory only, and inside the image only compiles the program files and imports modules (no service code runs, no model, no network). The build itself fetches packages from PyPI, the PyTorch CPU index and a pinned jevlike archive, exactly what the Dockerfiles already do on a host; the images stay local to the runner. The trusted security gate (workflow_run on CI) and the required checks are unchanged; the new workflow is path-filtered and therefore not a required check, which ADR-0127 states. ci.yml gains one step (test/selftest_service_images.py), nothing removed. AGENTS.md gains the check command and a rule; nothing weakened. The new self-test also guards the workflow's read-only permissions.

limitations: Pre-existing (TM-16 baseline, not introduced here): the decision images install unpinned packages; ADR-0127 leaves hash locks for them undecided. The check makes a breaking release visible, it does not make builds reproducible.
The check neither starts a service nor loads a model; runtime incompatibilities of a model are not covered.
A path-filtered workflow cannot be a required check; it gates by the rule not to merge with failing CI.
Weekly failures show in the Actions tab and its notification, not on a pull request.
